verdict.rationale: Honcho documents a single context() call that returns curated reasoning plus conversation history for use at every turn, and says retrieval can be shaped with token budgets and summaries. That covers the one-call, token-budgeted, memory-assembled context block. All of this comes from marketing-level first-party pages. Missing for 10: detailed API docs showing the token-budget parameter on context() and the prompt-ready output format, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories in one call

citations.quote: context() returns instantly curated reasoning plus conversation history. Everything an agent needs to maintain continuity and efficient enough to use at every turn.
